# Based Math Game

> Free, open-source drills for converting numbers between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal, plus the topics around them (powers of two, two's complement, bitwise operations, binary addition, hex colors and ASCII). Play solo or in live multiplayer rooms of up to 10 players. Inspired by zetamac. No sign-up is needed to play; a free account adds leaderboards and synced history.

- Site: https://based-math-game.web.app
- Source (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/hajin-park/based-math-game
- Issues and contact: https://github.com/hajin-park/based-math-game/issues

## How a round works

You see a value and type its conversion. The answer submits itself the moment it is correct, and the next question appears. Prefixes (0x, 0b, 0o) are optional, hex is case-insensitive, leading zeros up to the question's width are accepted, and spaces or underscores between digits are ignored. Tab skips a question; Esc pauses.

## Topics (in learning order)

- Foundations: Nibbles (4-bit binary, hex and decimal, 0–15); Powers of Two (2^0 to 2^16).
- Core: Binary Bytes (binary ↔ decimal, 0–255); Hex Bytes (hex ↔ decimal and binary, 8-bit); Octal (octal ↔ binary and decimal, 0–511); Mixed Bases (a blend of the core topics).
- Advanced: 16-bit Words (hex ↔ decimal and binary, 0–65535); Two's Complement (8-bit, −128 to 127); Bitwise Operations (AND, OR, XOR and shifts on 8-bit values); Binary Addition (8-bit, with carries).
- Applied: Colors & ASCII (hex color channels → decimal, ASCII characters ↔ hex codes).
- Custom drills: any conversion pairs and ranges, shareable as a link.

## Formats

- Sprint: 60 seconds, most correct answers wins (ranked).
- Speedrun: first to 15 correct answers, fastest time wins; each skip adds 5 seconds (ranked).
- Survival: three lives and a shrinking per-question clock that climbs from nibbles to bitwise (ranked).
- Daily: the same 10 questions for everyone each UTC day; one ranked attempt; each skip adds 10 seconds.
- Practice: untimed, with hints and worked step-by-step solutions (not ranked).

## Pages

- /play — pick a topic and format; /play?mode=<topic>:<format> links straight to a mode (for example /play?mode=bytes-hex:sprint).
- /daily — today's challenge and its leaderboard.
- /learn — a short course with interactive widgets, one lesson per topic (for example /learn#twos-complement).
- /multiplayer — create a room or join with an 8-character code; the host picks the mode and everyone gets the same questions.
- /leaderboard — top results per ranked mode and per daily challenge (registered accounts only).
- /how-to-play, /about, /privacy, /terms.

## Accounts and data

Guests are anonymous Firebase accounts: they can play everything, including multiplayer, and their history stays in the browser. Registered accounts (email and password, or Google) store profile, settings, run history, stats and leaderboard entries in Firebase. Display names and scores on leaderboards are public. Accounts can be deleted from the profile page, which removes their data. There are no ads, analytics or tracking cookies.

## Built with

React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI and Firebase (Authentication, Realtime Database, Firestore, Hosting).
